blocks.html: Where a structure is assigned to Seismic Design Category C in accordance with Section 1613, precast prestressed concrete piles shall have transverse reinforcement in accordance with this section. The minimum volumetric ratio of spiral reinforcement shall not be less than the amount required by the following formula for the upper 20 feet (6096 mm) of the precast prestressed concrete pile.
blocks.plainText: Where a structure is assigned to Seismic Design Category C in accordance with Section 1613 , precast prestressed concrete piles shall have transverse reinforcement in accordance with this section. The minimum volumetric ratio of spiral reinforcement shall not be less than the amount required by the following formula for the upper 20 feet (6096 mm) of the precast prestressed concrete pile.

   Exception: The minimum spiral reinforcement index required by Equation 18-1 shall not apply in cases where the design includes full consideration of load combinations specified in ASCE 7, Section 2.3.6 and the applicable overstrength factor, Ω0 .
